C-SESSION-PART-EXTRACTOR.IntentSummary: Adapt the bundled vvoc-project-session-history extractor to the post-2026-11-25 storage layout: assistant text joined from session_part for rows with empty inline content, edit/write tool parts feeding changed_files, truthful three-era documentation, percent-encoded read-only URI, an explicit run-command substitution note, a python3-gated synthetic-schema regression test mirroring session-graph.test.ts, and a live smoke run proving ASSISTANT lines return — superseding the predecessor's byte-identity freeze with recorded content markers.

MustPassCommand.Command: bun test src/lib/managed-skills.test.ts src/lib/managed-skills.grammar.test.ts src/lib/managed-agents.test.ts src/lib/opencode.test.ts

T-001.Title: Read post-migration parts in the extractor: session_part text join, edit/write file collection, percent-encoded URI.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: modern_messages loads a session's session_part type='text' rows once (WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY message_id, ordinal) when the table exists, groups them by message_id, and uses them as the text for session_message rows whose inline extraction is empty; inline non-empty rows are untouched, and reasoning/tool parts are never read as text.

changed_files reads session_part tool parts for the session, filters JSON names edit and write, and passes their data through collect_files_from_json so state.input.path lands in the file list when inside the root.
connect_readonly percent-encodes the database path (urllib.parse.quote) before composing the mode=ro URI.

T-002.Title: Update the shipped documentation to the three-era truth and the explicit run-command substitution.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: SKILL.md's Data Source Layout describes the three storage eras — V1 message+part, V2 inline session_message content, and the post-2026-11-25 layout where assistant text and patch parts live in session_part — and the workflow's run command names the substitution of the skill's own directory explicitly instead of presenting a verbatim-runnable relative path.
README's skill row states the current part store accurately instead of claiming history lives only in session_v2/session_message.

T-003.Title: Add the python3-gated synthetic-schema regression test.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/lib/session-history.test.ts mirrors the session-graph.test.ts pattern: python3 via Bun.which with test.skipIf, a temp SQLite database built with bun:sqlite, and execFileSync running the shipped script with --db and a temp project directory.

The fixtures cover: post-migration extraction (assistant content=[] plus session_part text/reasoning/tool parts — ASSISTANT line present, reasoning absent), pre-migration inline content (unchanged output), a legacy V1 table pair (unchanged output), and edit/write tool parts contributing files while other tools do not.

T-004.Title: Run the gates and the live smoke run, record evidence, reconcile projections, archive, and ship.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The grace lint baseline, target, and final assertion gates pass for this change, and bun run check, build, and pack:check pass fresh.

A live smoke run against the current OpenCode database returns at least one ASSISTANT line for a post-migration session; the command, output excerpt, and date are recorded in the bundle's smoke-evidence.md.

The M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS graph purpose and the V-M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS scenario truthfully cover the session_part extraction and the new test file, and the change bundle is archived with applied statuses before the commit.
